mentions.name: Maylo
mentions.description: A Chrome extension providing text-to-speech and reading tools designed to help dyslexic readers access written content online. It supports Google Docs, PDFs, and the web, and aims to stay out of the way while offering better tracking, better voices, and lower cost than existing options. Writing support is planned next.
mentions.problem: The author's son has dyslexia and needed an easier way to access written content online and at school.
mentions.audience: People with dyslexia, including students needing reading support at school
mentions.source_excerpt: My son is dyslexic. So I built a Chrome text-to-speech and reading tools extension to make it easier for him to get access to written content online (and also to support him at school). It has support for Google Docs and PDFs as well as the web. There are a few of these, but this one tries to stay out of the way, have better tracking, better voices and lower cost.
mentions.author: zcrar70
